title: Cleopatra Lived Closer to Us Than to the Pyramids
script: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid. The Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around 2560 BC. Cleopatra died in 30 BC, about two and a half thousand years later. The Moon landing happened in 1969, roughly two thousand years after her. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient ruins. Ancient Egypt lasted so long that its own people were history fans.
